items.titleZh: Anthropic 发布了 Opus 5，其功能“接近”《神鬼寓言 5》
items.titleEn: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能领域的政策发展。消息来源的要点：在 Anthropic 与美国政府最近一次正面交锋几周后，以及主导科技行业讨论的 OpenAI 安全事件几天后，Anthropic 于周四发布了其最新型号 Claude Opus 5。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports a policy development in AI. Key point from the source: Weeks after Anthropic's latest toe-to-toe with the US government, and days after an OpenAI security incident that dominated tech industry discussions, Anthropic on Thursday released its newest model, Claude Opus 5.
items.overviewZh: The Verge AI 发布了有关“Anthropic 发布了 Opus 5 的最新更新，其功能‘接近’《神鬼寓言 5》”。
items.overviewEn: The Verge AI published a new update about “Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities”.
